data.one_liner: A Flutter widget library that helps users select days of the week.
data.what_it_does: Provides the SelectWeekDays widget for rendering day selection buttons. Allows customization of colors, borders, fonts, and text, and supports updating selected days dynamically using a GlobalKey.
use_when: You need a UI component for picking specific days of the week in a form or scheduler.
You want customizable styling for selected and unselected day buttons.
avoid_when: You need a full calendar date picker rather than a repeating weekly day selector.
strengths: Easy to implement with a clear widget constructor.
Offers broad styling options including background decoration, custom text colors, and borders.
Supports dynamic state changes after construction via GlobalKey.
weaknesses: Limited in scope strictly to days of the week selection.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need full calendar date selection instead of just days of the week.
